name: engulf
desc:
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} moves up to its Speed and can move through the spaces of Huge or smaller creatures and objects.
Strength Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=5o0Bh8PQaojx5XMx]], each creature or object whose space the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} enters for the first time during this move.
Failure: The target is engulfed. While engulfed, a target has &Reference[Total Cover] against attacks and other effects outside the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, and when the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} moves, the engulfed target moves with it. A nonmagical object is destroyed after spending 1 minute engulfed.
While engulfed, a creature takes [[/damage average activity=Exfa4q7O4SvXjGt7]] damage at the start of each of its turns, is &Reference[Suffocating]{suffocating}, has the &Reference[Restrained apply=long] condition, and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. An engulfed creature that is reduced to 0 Hit Points dissolves into ash, which is ejected into the Astral Sea.
Success: The target escapes and enters the nearest unoccupied space.
